detail.longDescription: What type of AI related business would you start that A) has a real value for its users and B) could realistically be bootstrapped and build by single person? I know OpenRouter wasn't launched by single person, but you get what I mean, it wouldn't have been overwhelming for a single good developer to build and launch. Since I don't only want to leech value I will give one idea myself: Hosting and access to unrestricted open source LLMs for cybersecurity, agent testing, defense & biological research -> Downside is obviously unclear legal risks
